title: findprop
summary: Find property metadata on an object or handle object.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side metadata lookup. GPU provider kernels do not participate.

description: `prop = findprop(obj, name)` returns property metadata for class-defined or dynamic properties. Dynamic properties on handle objects return a `matlab.metadata.DynamicProperty` handle; class-defined properties return a `matlab.metadata.Property` object. Missing properties return an empty double.
behaviors: The target must be an object or valid handle object.
Dynamic property lookup on handle objects returns a metadata handle that can later be passed to `delete`.
Class-defined property lookup returns metadata fields including `Name`, `DefiningClass`, `GetAccess`, `SetAccess`, and `Dependent`.

faqs.question: Can metadata returned by `findprop` for class-defined properties be deleted?
faqs.answer: No. Only dynamic property metadata handles returned for per-instance properties can be deleted.

faqs.question: Does `findprop` invoke user methods?
faqs.answer: No. It inspects runtime class and object metadata only.

gpu_residency: `findprop` inspects host-side metadata and returns host metadata values.
limitations: External MATLAB MAT-file class metadata is not decoded into dynamic property metadata.
